topic: The real reason you can't remember being a baby — and it's terrifying
hook: You can't remember being a baby. The reason is terrifying.
script: You can't remember being a baby. The reason is terrifying. Your hippocampus — the brain's memory centre — isn't fully developed until age 3. Memories form but can't be stored long term. So you experienced years of life, pain, joy, love — and none of it was saved. Your earliest experiences shaped you. You just can't access them. Follow for facts about your brain that feel wrong.
